limits: Every value is synthetic; the corpus demonstrates mechanism and makes no claim about real audiences.
The zh-shuang text is Golden B's structurally valid but culturally minimal slice; no cultural representativeness is claimed.
Holdout observations carry future-dated windows (after registered_at) by construction; replay refuses any evaluation observation older than registration.
Shot masters are stylized rooms drawn where the pinned spatial fixture places its objects (tests/integration/r2/m8f_utility_support.py SHOT_PATTERNS).

baseline.description: The same corpus through ArcReel host surfaces only (admission, approved shot masters, export); no M8 route is called. Baseline deliverable counts are measured by running it, not assumed.

endpoints.deliverable: an exploration with at least two sibling alternatives and its history, reloaded intact and bound to the cohort lineage
gates: approved master bytes and heads unchanged

endpoints.deliverable: a promoted spatial constraint set on a registered target, available to generation
a lineage-bound recommendation whose direction holds on the registered holdout
9:16 and 1:1 projections promoted into their format slots
gates: preview and promotion bound to the source master

effect_policy.smallest_useful_effect: For each cohort and each capability, M8 delivers at least minimum_delta more gated deliverables than the baseline, with zero regressions of baseline deliverables (approved master bytes and heads byte-identical).
effect_policy.confidence: Deterministic: two independent runs from an empty database must produce identical artifact digests and verdicts. No sampling inference. Review verdict proportions are reported as exact counts with a Wilson 95% interval, descriptive only.
effect_policy.causal_language: Forbidden. The design class is offline and sequential; hypotheses stay associative (r2.learning.cohorts causal-language guard).
effect_policy.pilot_confirmatory: Not applicable: deterministic outputs and one reviewer give no variance to estimate; recorded as deviation NO_CONFIRMATORY_SAMPLE.

rubrics.calibration: One unlabelled format item is a projection with muted audio (scripts/r2/m8f_review_packet.py); a reviewer's cohort verdicts count only if it independently marks that item's audio FAIL.
One unlabelled spatial item adds a VISIBLE 'green sofa' span over bare wall; a reviewer's cohort verdicts count only if it independently marks that item's visible_assertions_supported_by_frames FAIL.

reviewers.reviewer_ref: reviewer A: a fresh Claude agent with no conversation context
reviewers.conflict_declaration: did not implement M8-F; does not see the label key, calibration identities, expected verdicts, other reviews or evidence records

reviewers.reviewer_ref: reviewer B: a fresh Codex agent
reviewers.conflict_declaration: did not implement M8-F; same isolation as reviewer A

deviations.statement: ADR-0108: two independent model reviewers replace two qualified human reviewers; no human reviews the M8-F artifacts.
Reviews run on an offline packet of the recorded bytes, without in-app grant custody (exercised in M8-E).
Spatial frames are drawn to match the pinned fixture; the review checks pipeline fidelity, not model perception.
Deterministic outputs; no pilot variance or confirmatory sample size.
The implementing agent built the packet and holds the key; it does not review.

resource_envelope.basis: Host ceilings (server.services.format_render.RENDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1800); M8-E recorded no resource measurements, so no tighter empirical ceiling exists. Human review time is excluded.

replay_determinism.must_match: every field of each cohort record except the RUN_SCOPED list in the verifier (generated ids, wall-clock times, grant events and digests chaining over them); run 2 vs run 1 in each database and run 1 across SQLite and PostgreSQL

invariants: staging review renders equal the automated run digests
a forged-lineage client Canvas append is refused (ADR-0107)
non_authorization: This protocol and any result under it authorize no production activation, deployment, provider or platform call, credential use or publication.

supersedes.reason: ADR-0108 amendment 1: reviewer A under v2 was the implementer holding the label key, and the v2 reviewer prompt disclosed the calibration verdicts; v3 uses two fresh blind model reviewers. v2 reviews do not count toward acceptance.

review_disagreement_policy: Item disagreements are retained; any material disagreement blocks acceptance until an adjudication is recorded.
review_procedure: Each reviewer receives only the packet path and the rubric item definitions, runs as a separate agent, and returns per-item verdicts with measured reasons. The implementing agent merges the outputs with the key afterwards.
